serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Thank God for Helga. That lady is so old she probably remembers times when steam engines were still around. She thinks that all these sexbots in da other room are dolls or some shit.
You: Big Daddy, I don’t want to spoil your fun, but aren’t you snorting too much and too fast?
Big Daddy: Don’t worry! I have years of experience and a sensor inside my body that automatically calls 911 when I overdose.
Big Daddy: It wasn’t cheap, but it does da job. 
Big Daddy: Either way, my body is quite big as you can see, so I usually run out of drugs before something bad happens. 
Big Daddy: Anyway, what did you want to talk about? 
You: I wanted to ask you how you managed to collect all these parts and set up a shop.
Big Daddy: That’s a really long story, little one.
Big Daddy: Oh man, that’s a lot of bad memories coming back at {gv_Hour}, after 14 hours of working and high on drugs. 
You: We can talk about it at a later date if you want.
Big Daddy: That’s very nice of you, but I can’t do it to you after you came all da way here, looking for answers.
You: I insist. There is always the next day.
Big Daddy: Oh little one, you really have a heart of gold. Let’s do it as you said then. I will make sure to answer your questions next time you come over.
You: Alright, take some sleep man. 
Big Daddy: I will. Take care little one. Bye!
You: Goodnight.
